item.title: Federal Legal Landscape
item.description: Under federal law, cannabis (marijuana) remains a Schedule I controlled substance. The DEA confirms that marijuana has “no currently accepted medical use” and remains illegal to cultivate(https://www.dea.gov/sites/default/files/…
